recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Renaming the already-published status parameter to currentStatus would be a compatibility-affecting API change and is not supported by the applied source history, published R5 surface, or sibling backport surface.
issue_request: FHIR-30381 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core R5 change request asking for Subscription/$status to accept an optional list of Subscription.status values on the type-level /Subscription/$status operation. The resolution said to add a code parameter bound to http://hl7.org/fhir/subscription-status and to match the R4 backport issue FHIR-30382.
initial_application: The current source history already applies the request: commit 17740f61cd added the R4B-derived type-level status input parameter, commit 26b1acc56b explicitly applied FHIR-30381 by adding the required ValueSet/subscription-status binding, commit e981c42de8 scoped id and status to type-level use, and commit f1da78150b clarified the id/status documentation for FHIR-30379.
additional_context: Although the Jira resolution prose used the name currentStatus, the current source, the published R5 OperationDefinition, and the published subscriptions-backport OperationDefinition all use the parameter name status. That matches the issue title's request to filter by Subscription.status and the already-published API surface. The January 2021 Subscriptions Track Confluence page lists FHIR-30381 and sibling FHIR-30382, while targeted Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active source/subscription/operationdefinition-Subscription-status.xml already defines a repeating, type-scoped input parameter named status with type code, a required binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/subscription-status, and documentation describing Resource-level filtering and OR semantics.

related_jiras.note: Sibling subscriptions-backport issue with the same request and resolution language; used as context because the published backport operation also uses the status parameter name.
Later core issue clarified the id and status parameter documentation for the same $status operation without renaming the status filter.
